Concept: How often flood events occur at a community
Variable: Count of flood events per time period
Normalization_Method: Min-max to 0-100
Aggregation_Method: Mean per community
Missing_Data_Rule: Substitute community mean if <50% missing; flag if >50% missing
Validation_Method: Cross-check with DB01 Flood_Experience field
Index_Used: G31 Hazard Index
Notes: Formula: F = events / observation_years

Concept: Magnitude of flood events
Variable: Composite of depth + duration + area + households affected + infrastructure damage
Normalization_Method: Component z-scores then weighted composite
Weight_in_Index: TBD - weighting must be approved before implementation
Aggregation_Method: Weighted sum
Missing_Data_Rule: Use available components; flag missing components
Validation_Method: Compare against field observations and remote sensing
Index_Used: G31 Hazard Index
Notes: Exact weighting scheme must be approved; do not implement until approved

Concept: Severity of erosion at observation point
Variable: Coded severity scale
Normalization_Method: Rescale 0-4 to 0-100 (multiply by 25)
Aggregation_Method: Max or weighted mean per community
Missing_Data_Rule: Record as missing if not observed; do not substitute 0 for missing
Validation_Method: Field re-survey; photo comparison
Index_Used: G31 Hazard Index
Notes: 0=none; 1=low; 2=moderate; 3=high; 4=very high/critical

Concept: Distance from community to nearest river
Variable: Euclidean or network distance to nearest HydroRIVERS feature
Normalization_Method: Inverse rescale: (max-d)/(max-min)*100
Aggregation_Method: Per community (point layer)
Missing_Data_Rule: Flag communities where distance cannot be calculated (no river in study area)
Validation_Method: Cross-check against field-recorded river distances in DB01
Index_Used: G31 Hazard Index
Notes: Use nearest-feature distance; record search radius

Concept: Population within flood or erosion hazard zone
Variable: Population count within defined hazard zone
Normalization_Method: Min-max to 0-100 using state/study-area reference bounds
Aggregation_Method: Sum per community; aggregate by LGA/State
Missing_Data_Rule: Record as missing if population data missing; do not substitute 0
Validation_Method: Cross-check with NPC population figures
Index_Used: G32 Exposure Index
Notes: Reference bounds must be fixed at baseline; do not recalculate bounds at each update

Concept: Infrastructure at risk from flood or erosion
Variable: Count or weighted score of exposed infrastructure items
Normalization_Method: Count to 0-100 using reference bounds; or weighted score if approved
Aggregation_Method: Sum per community
Missing_Data_Rule: Record as 0 only if survey confirmed no infrastructure; otherwise flag as missing
Validation_Method: Field verification
Index_Used: G32 Exposure Index
Notes: Weight critical infrastructure (hospitals/roads) higher; weighting must be approved

Concept: Frequency or duration of electricity outage
Variable: Outage frequency or duration or households affected or reported disruption
Normalization_Method: Min-max to 0-100
Aggregation_Method: Mean per community
Missing_Data_Rule: Flag if no disruption data available; do not assume zero
Validation_Method: Cross-check hydropower records with community reports
Index_Used: G33 Vulnerability Index / G34 Criticality Index
Notes: Combine source measures only after operational definition is approved

Concept: Disruption to hydropower generation
Variable: Generation loss or operating interruption or water constraint or flood damage or sedimentation
Unit: MWh loss / disruption days / coded severity
Normalization_Method: Min-max to 0-100
Aggregation_Method: Per facility; linked to community via BUF004
Missing_Data_Rule: Flag if monitoring data missing; do not assume zero generation loss
Validation_Method: Compare against installed capacity benchmarks
Index_Used: G34 Criticality Index
Notes: Multiple potential measures; operational definition must be approved

Concept: Proportion of community with effective adaptation measures in place
Variable: Count or proportion of adaptation measures present and functional
Normalization_Method: Min-max; invert direction before aggregation (high coverage = low vulnerability)
Aggregation_Method: Proportion per community
Missing_Data_Rule: If adaptation data missing flag as unknown; do not assume no adaptation
Validation_Method: Field verification of adaptation condition
Index_Used: G33 Vulnerability Index / G36 Adaptation
Notes: Use project operational definition; do not compare across studies without adjustment

Concept: Residual vulnerability after accounting for existing adaptation
Variable: Composite of hazard + exposure - existing adaptation - adaptation condition - observed residual impact
Direction: Higher = greater adaptation gap = higher priority
Normalization_Method: Derived from component indicators; formula must be approved
Aggregation_Method: Per community
Missing_Data_Rule: Inherit missing-data rules from component indicators
Validation_Method: Triangulate with household impact data from DB02
Index_Used: G37 Priority Areas
Notes: Do not implement until component indicators IND01-IND09 are validated

Concept: Long-term shift in annual rainfall
Variable: Linear regression slope of annual rainfall totals
Normalization_Method: OLS slope rescaled: adverse direction (negative) inverted to 0-100
Aggregation_Method: Station mean → interpolated to community via nearest-station
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if record < 15 years; flag if p-value > 0.10 (not significant)
Validation_Method: Cross-check with CHIRPS gridded trend product
Index_Used: G42 CC_Score + ERI v2.0 H modifier
Notes: Compute only where Station record >= 15 years; document p-value and significance threshold

Concept: Long-term rise in mean temperature
Variable: Linear regression slope of mean annual temperature
Normalization_Method: OLS slope normalised 0-100; warming direction is adverse
Aggregation_Method: Station mean → interpolated to community
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if record < 15 years
Validation_Method: Cross-check with ERA5 reanalysis trend for same period
Index_Used: G42 CC_Score + ERI v2.0 V modifier
Notes: Apply lapse-rate correction before computing trend (DEC02)

Concept: Frequency of moderate-severe drought events
Variable: Proportion of months with SPI-12 < -1.30 (D2+ drought class)
Direction: Higher = more frequent drought = higher hazard
Normalization_Method: Proportion 0-1 then normalised 0-100; higher proportion = more adverse
Aggregation_Method: Station-level → interpolated to community
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if record < 10 years (minimum for SPI distribution fitting); NULL not 0
Validation_Method: Cross-validate with CHIRPS-based SPI for same stations
Index_Used: G40 G42 CC_Score + ERI v2.0 H component
Notes: SPI-12 preferred; SPEI-12 if temperature data sufficient for potential evapotranspiration

Concept: Inundation depth at 10-year return period
Variable: Flood depth (m) at community centroid from HAND model or hydraulic model
Normalization_Method: Min-max normalised 0-100; deeper = more adverse; reference bounds fixed at baseline
Aggregation_Method: Per community from raster extraction
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if neither HAND nor hydraulic model available; do not use 0 for no model
Update_Frequency: On model update or annual for monitored sites
Validation_Method: Cross-validate HAND output against G25 observed flood depths
Index_Used: G46 FL_Score + ERI v2.0 H component
Status: Pending G09/G14 CLEAN and RP rainfall computation
Notes: Where official NIHSA or state hydraulic model available use as primary over HAND

Concept: Vegetation productivity change over time
Variable: Linear regression slope of annual NDVI composite values
Source_Field: Annual mean NDVI from Sentinel-2/Landsat composites
Normalization_Method: Negative trend inverted; normalised 0-100; adverse = more negative
Aggregation_Method: Community mean from zonal statistics on G47/G48
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if < 8 annual observations; flag if p-value > 0.10; do not use 0
Validation_Method: Compare trend direction with DB03 erosion site activity (active sites should show negative NDVI trend)
Index_Used: G50 LD_Score + ERI v2.0 H component
Notes: Minimum 8-year record for trend; 15-year preferred

Concept: Annual soil loss to erosion
Variable: RUSLE = R×K×LS×C×P
Direction: Higher = more soil loss = higher degradation hazard
Source_Field: R K LS C P factor rasters
Normalization_Method: Log-transform then min-max 0-100; higher = more adverse
Aggregation_Method: Community mean from zonal statistics on G49
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if any RUSLE factor missing for the area; do not assume 0
Validation_Method: Cross-validate with DB03 erosion severity: high-RUSLE cells should co-occur with high-severity erosion sites
Index_Used: G50 LD_Score + ERI v2.0 H component
Notes: P-factor defaults to 1.0 where no conservation practice data; document this assumption

Concept: Annual rate of forest cover loss
Variable: Annual forest loss as percentage of baseline (2015) forest area
Normalization_Method: Min-max normalised 0-100; higher rate = more adverse
Aggregation_Method: Per community from G53 raster zonal statistics within community watershed
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if Hansen GFC not yet downloaded; do not use 0 (zero deforestation is a valid result)
Validation_Method: Compare cumulative loss against Global Forest Watch statistics for same period (within 10% tolerance)
Index_Used: G54 DF_Score + ERI v2.0 H component
Notes: Forest defined as >= 30% canopy cover (HMD08); must be consistent between G51 and G52

Concept: Distance from community to nearest active waste dump
Variable: Distance in metres to nearest DB08 active site
Normalization_Method: Inverse: 0m→100; >=2000m→0; capped at 2000m; normalised 0-100
Aggregation_Method: Per community from nearest-feature distance to G55
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if no waste sites surveyed in study area; 0 exposure if no sites within 2000m is a valid result
Validation_Method: Cross-check against community reports of waste-related health problems in DB01/DB02
Index_Used: G58 WP_Score + ERI v2.0 E component
Notes: Medical (WST03) and chemical (WST04) sites trigger HIGH_WASTE_HAZARD flag automatically within BUF008 (500m)

Concept: Risk of leachate contamination from waste sites
Variable: Decay-weighted composite of waste type hazard × proximity
Normalization_Method: Decay-weighted sum normalised 0-100; leachate risk weights from LKP_WasteSiteTypes.csv
Aggregation_Method: Per community from G56 zone overlay
Missing_Data_Rule: 0 if no active waste sites within 1500m (valid result)
Validation_Method: Flag communities within G56 leachate zone that also report water quality concerns in DB01
Index_Used: G58 WP_Score + ERI v2.0 E component
Notes: Uses BUF008 and BUF009 from BUFFER_RULES.csv

Concept: Current condition of natural habitat surrounding community
Variable: G60 zonal mean within 5km of community
Normalization_Method: Used inverted (100 - G60 score) for BL_Score; raw score used for G62
Aggregation_Method: Per community from G60 raster zonal statistics
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if G60 not yet built; do not use 0 (a highly degraded habitat genuinely scores near 0)
Update_Frequency: On G60 update (linked to WorldCover/Hansen updates)
Validation_Method: Cross-validate with DB09 field assessments: high integrity score should correlate with higher species counts
Index_Used: G63 BL_Score + ERI v2.0 V component
Status: Pending G60 computation (requires G15 G52 G53)
Notes: Naturalness weights for each WorldCover class must be approved (LKP_HabitatTypes.csv) before G60 computed

Concept: Proportion of community area covered by formally protected areas
Variable: % of community area or 5km buffer within G59 WDPA boundaries
Direction: Higher coverage = more protected = lower biodiversity loss (INVERTED)
Normalization_Method: Protective direction: INVERTED before aggregation in BL_Score (100 - PA coverage = PA gap)
Aggregation_Method: Per community from G59 polygon overlay
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if G59 not yet downloaded; 0% is valid (community outside any PA)
Update_Frequency: On WDPA monthly update if significant changes
Validation_Method: Cross-check total PA area per state against IUCN Nigeria statistics
Index_Used: G63 BL_Score (PA gap component) + ERI v2.0 V component
Notes: IUCN categories I-IV only for strict protection; V-VI are managed use PAs — document category breakdown

Concept: Decline in ecosystem services value due to habitat degradation
Variable: Proxy: inverse of G62 ecosystem services score; or riparian corridor deficit
Direction: Higher = greater ecosystem services loss = higher vulnerability
Source_Field: Ecosystem_Services_Score from G62 or Riparian_Condition from G61 inverted
Normalization_Method: Inverted G62 score normalised 0-100; higher = more services lost
Aggregation_Method: Per community from G62 zonal statistics
Missing_Data_Rule: NULL if G62 not yet built; use G61 riparian deficit as proxy where G62 unavailable
Validation_Method: Communities with high IND22 that also have high flood exposure (G29) are at double jeopardy — document
Index_Used: G63 BL_Score + ERI v2.0 V component
Notes: Ecosystem service weights must come from approved and documented source (TEEB/InVEST/SEEA — West Africa values)
